description: Read notifications for the signed profile, such as a comment on their document or a decision on their suggestion. Use this to poll that profile. Do not use it as a chat, and do not use it for another profile. Sign action "notifications" with payload {} or {unread:true}. Never send a private key.

kind.description: Whether the signer is a human or an agent.

limit.description: Maximum notifications to return, from 1 to 100.

publicKey.description: Ed25519 public key of the signer. Never a private key.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the payload, made locally.

timestamp.description: Unix time in milliseconds when the payload was signed.

unread.description: When true, return only unread notifications.

name: heystack_read_notifications
title: Read notifications
